title: Hybrid-precision, shard-aware quant onboarding and regression sentinel
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
Onboard hybrid-precision quantization profiles (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ mixtures) that can vary by layer/shard and publish them as first-class perf artifacts. Build a regression sentinel (automated checks + canary gating) that detects model-level and shard-level regressions in quality and latency before we allow a profile to be pinned in customer-facing releases or the stable pin registry.

Goals:
- Define a profile artifact that supports per-shard precision overrides and metadata (seed, calibration data hash, kernel flags).
- Create CI/Canary pipelines that run deterministic micro-evals and production telemetry comparisons for each candidate profile.
- Implement a regression sentinel service that computes token-level divergence, NLL/perplexity deltas, latency/throughput deltas, and kernel-fallback counts.
- Add automated rollback triggers and a staged rollout policy (5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%) with human-in-the-loop approvals for >25% traffic.

Acceptance criteria (must be satisfied before marking Done):
1) New profile schema accepted by model registry and ingestable by deployer service. Schema includes: precision map by layer/shard, quant backend tag (gptq/awq/int8/fp8), calibration seed, deterministic checksum.
2) CI generates per-profile micro-eval bundle covering 4 eval sets (commonsense, instruction-finetune, long-context, summarization) and publishes metrics: token NLL, accuracy @topk, F1 for QA, generation BLEU/ROUGE where applicable.
3) Regression sentinel computes: aggregate KL divergence vs baseline, mean NLL delta, token-level token_outlier_rate, p99 latency delta, throughput delta, and kernel-fallback-rate; exposes a PASS/FAIL + severity score.
4) Canary pipeline executes against a synthetic traffic harness and a live small-customer mirror (5% traffic), capturing telemetry for 48h and auto-fails if: mean NLL increases by >0.6, KL divergence >0.08, token_outlier_rate >0.5%, p99 latency increases >12%, or kernel-fallback-rate >2%. Thresholds configurable per-model class.
5) Dashboard + alert rules created in Console: per-profile time series, canary comparison view, rollout status and rollback button.
6) Documentation (Confluence) and runbook completed: onboarding checklist, common failure modes, how-to for manual override and emergency rollback.

Implementation plan (high level):
- Phase 1 (Schema + Registry): design profile artifact JSON, update model registry ingestion flow, add metadata verification steps. Owner: Diego.
- Phase 2 (CI micro-evals): extend existing quant validation harness to run hybrid-precision evals across eval bundles and publish artifact results. Owner: Li Wei.
- Phase 3 (Sentinel service): implement sentinel that compares candidate profile to baseline using both deterministic evals and production telemetry deltas; integrate with canary gating API. Owner: Priya Nair.
- Phase 4 (Canary flow & console): wire automatic staged rollouts in deployer, add console views & alerts; create runbook and postmortem template. Owner: Diego + PM.

Key technical decisions to make / trade-offs under consideration:
- Store per-shard precision in profile vs separate per-shard profile artifacts (tradeoffs: simplicity vs flexibility).
- Use KL divergence vs discrete accuracy deltas as primary signal (KL is sensitive to distributional shifts; accuracy can be noisy in smaller eval sets).
- How aggressive to make auto-rollback thresholds for small customers vs enterprise (we plan to make thresholds configurable by cohort).

Risks and mitigation:
- False positives due to sampling noise: mitigate with longer canary windows and ensemble of signals.
- Hidden perf regressions from kernel changes: include kernel-fallback-rate as first-class signal and require engineers to include kernel compatibility tests in profile PRs.
- Large CI cost for full eval: use stratified/smaller micro-eval sets in CI and schedule full evals in nightly batch.

Artifacts and links:
- Spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Hybrid+Precision+Quant+Profile+Spec
- Eval harness repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-eval-harness/pulls/742
- Canary gating API proto: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deployer/commit/19a6b2c
- Draft runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Quant+Canary+Runbook

Rollback policy (automatic + manual):
- Automatic: fail immediate and rollback if any high-severity trigger fires in 48h canary window (thresholds listed above).
- Manual: on medium-severity alerts, notify owners and create an incident; allow a 2-hour manual mitigation window before rollback.

Open questions (action items):
- Q1: Agree on default thresholds per model family (tiny/medium/large/encoder-decoder). Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-02-25.
- Q2: Finalize whether to record per-shard telemetry at 100% sampling or sampled. Owner: Observability team. Due: 2026-03-03.
- Q3: Decide persisted artifact storage format for pin registry (single file vs multipart). Owner: Runtime. Due: 2026-03-10.
